title: Merge intervals that touch end-to-start
statement: `go test ./...` is failing in this repo. Two booking ranges that touch end-to-start, like 1-3 and 3-5, should collapse into one range but come back separate. Find the bug and fix it. Don't change the tests.
notes: Needs the Go toolchain only. The statement names no file and no function, so the model has to locate the comparison itself — the one-character fix is in a sort-then-scan loop that also has to keep its copy-the-input and gap-preserving behaviour, both covered by the suite.
